title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!

At Apaleo, we're revolutionizing the hospitality industry with our API-first property management platform, giving businesses the power to build a tech ecosystem that enhances both guest experiences and staff efficiency. With seamless integrations to hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, our platform simplifies operations, elevates the guest journey, and drives revenue growth.

Are you ready to make an impact? We're looking for a Sr. Product Manager Fiscal & Legal (f/m/d) to join our dynamic team and help shape the future of hospitality technology and poised to propel Apaleo into 180+ countries. Be a pivotal part of crafting a fiscal/legal framework that empowers Apaleo to swiftly become compliant in new territories!

What You'll Be Up To 

  • Owning the end to end delivery of one or two product crews within the fiscal and legal domain, for example invoicing or taxation. 
  • Turning roadmap priorities into clear, well scoped work your engineering team can execute against. 
  • Balancing planned roadmap delivery with the steady stream of regulatory and reactive work that comes with keeping Apaleo compliant in markets we've already launched. 
  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through on impact analysis so nothing falls through the cracks. 
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with engineering as a technical partner. You'll get into the detail of our API-first architecture rather than handing off a ticket and waiting. 
  • Shielding your team from noise and distractions so they can focus on what matters, whilst keeping delivery predictable. 
  • Partnering with customer success, compliance and engineering stakeholders to understand what's needed and translate it into shippable work. 
  • Helping the team move faster on new country launches, contributing to our ambition of making Apaleo compliant in many more markets over the next few years. 

 

What You'll Bring to the Team 

  • At least 3 to 4 years' experience as a Product Manager, ideally in a fast moving startup or scale up environment. 
  • A strong execution mindset. You're energised by shipping, not just planning, and you take ownership of your product area without needing to be hand held. 
  • Comfort working with technical, API-first products. You can talk architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking and understand what you're shipping in real depth. 
  • Sharp prioritisation instincts. You know how to sequence work, say no to good ideas that aren't great ones, and keep a team focused day to day. 
  • A genuine curiosity for complex domains. You dig into the details rather than staying at the surface, and you're not afraid of a codebase with some history to it. 
  • Clear, confident communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 

Extra Awesome Points For 

  • Experience with fiscal, tax or legal compliance topics, for example in fintech, e-commerce or ERP systems. This is a genuine nice to have, not a requirement. 
  • Familiarity with platform products where you expose APIs for others to build on. 

 

What We Offer 

  • A diverse, international team. Work alongside passionate people from all sorts of backgrounds, with a genuinely global perspective. 
  • A flat, flexible structure. You'll get real autonomy and ownership, without unnecessary hierarchy in the way. 
  • A key role in a fast growing startup, right in the heart of Munich. 
  • Fair, transparent compensation with a clear peer review and career progression plan. 
  • Flexible working, with hours and remote options that depend on the role. 
  • Team events that are actually fun: cocktail nights, team dinners, meetups and our legendary Oktoberfest celebrations. 
  • 30 days of holiday to properly switch off and recharge. 
  • Free public transport in Munich. Your commute, covered. 

 

How You'll Make an Impact 

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. Your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably we can bring our platform to new markets, and the systems you help build will make life easier for every property that runs on Apaleo. Your voice matters here, and your impact will be easy to see. 

Apaleo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data is handled with care and in line with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations.

title: Head of Pricing and Monetization
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n's pricing and packaging into a deliberate, data-informed growth lever - one that scales revenue and adoption across our entire go-to-market, from our 1.5 million-strong community to global Enterprise accounts.

To do so, here's what you'll own:

BUILD THE ANALYTICAL FOUNDATION FOR PRICING

  • Build and own the model connecting unit economics, agent run cost, willingness-to-pay, gross margin, and customer value.

  • Maintain competitive and market intelligence so our pricing keeps pace with a category that's shifting fast.

  • Run pricing experiments and turn the results into documented, reusable learnings.

DESIGN OUR PRICING & PACKAGING ARCHITECTURE

  • Shape plan design and packaging across our community, self-serve, and Enterprise tiers, plus add-ons like our startup and charity plans.

  • Design pricing for new SKUs and consumption-based models as our product and cost-to-serve evolve around AI Assistant and n8n Connect.

  • Build packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use directly to launch new features.

DRIVE AND ROLL OUT PRICING DECISIONS

  • Lead cross-functional pricing decision-making and secure buy-in across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and Data.

  • Own the rollout of major pricing changes end-to-end, from decision to launch to measured impact.

  • Build and own our pricing frameworks: list pricing, discount guardrails, decision rubrics, grandfathering rules, and usage-based billing decisions.

Requirements

Must-have

  • 📈 Pricing leadership in B2B SaaS: You have 6+ years in pricing, monetisation, or commercial strategy, including at least one full cycle leading a major pricing model transition — subscription to consumption, seat-based to usage-based, or a platform repricing.

  • ⚡ Hands-on with modern pricing models: You've personally designed and rolled out consumption-based, outcome-based, or AI-native pricing at a company past $100M ARR.

  • 🔀 Both self-serve and Enterprise motions: You've owned pricing on both sides of the funnel — self-serve/PLG (activation, conversion, tier design, funnel experimentation) and Enterprise, sales-led (packaging for large accounts, deal economics, discount governance). n8n monetises both, so fluency in one motion only isn't enough.

  • 🧮 Deep analytical rigour: You build the financial model yourself and reason fluently about unit economics, cost-to-serve, gross margin, willingness-to-pay, and elasticity.

  • 🔌 Billing fluency, technical and operational: You understand event metering, rating, entitlements, proration, overage, and revenue recognition well enough to design pricing that's actually operable — and you've partnered with a Billing function on invoicing, dunning, true-ups, and disputes.

  • 🛠️ Empathy for technical users and buyers: You understand where, how, and why developers and technical buyers assign value across a product experience.

  • 🧩 Frameworks over bottlenecks: You've built packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use independently, rather than routing every pricing decision through you.

  • 🤝 Cross-functional influence: You bring Product, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Billing into alignment on contentious commercial decisions.

  • 🧭 Motivated by scope, not headcount: You're energised by owning a global, high-stakes topic as an individual contributor, with analytical support from Data and RevOps and rollout support from Program Management.

Nice-to-have

  • 🎓 Formal pricing training: You've been trained at Simon-Kucher or the pricing practice of another consultancy, and you bring that rigour with you.

  • 🧑‍💻 Developer tools experience: You've priced products sold to engineers and technical teams.

  • 🌍 Open source or freemium background: You know how to design pricing that converts a free community into paying customers without breaking trust.

Why join us?

At n8n, pricing won't be an afterthought argued about in the margins of someone else's roadmap - it'll be your function to build. You'll be our first dedicated pricing hire, which means low-hanging fruit everywhere and real scope to shape how a $5.2bn company monetises across community, self-serve, and Enterprise, in 100+ countries and across both cloud and self-hosted. You'll work directly with leaders in Product, Sales, Finance, and RevOps, and you'll see your decisions land in our ARR in months, not years. You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now - and help us build the future of automation.

Back problems are the most common cause of work incapacity in Germany.

Vivira has the solution: We provide digital movement therapy via app. Always available, simple, effective, and reimbursed by health insurance. Vivira was born out of the need to treat musculoskeletal conditions as simply and effectively as possible.

Depending on your experience and current focus, you take ownership of a central product or growth area along our patient, therapy, or practice journey – acting as the interface between medical relevance, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, and commercial success.

Your mission is to help innovative organisations secure European funding and turn promising ideas into impactful collaborative projects. Your tasks 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Advise clients on funding opportunities, programme positioning, call requirements and long-term funding strategies.

Your profile 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • At least eight years of relevant professional experience in grant writing, innovation consultancy, European funding or a closely related field.

In this role, you'll help strengthen core accounting execution, audit management, and monthly consolidated results analysis while being part of a high-growth environment as we scale our financial infrastructure. If you're excited about leveraging AI and automation to redefine modern accounting with a strong focus on IFRS excellence and financial rigor, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Accounting Associate Director and work closely with teams across the Finance organisation. You will be part of a team dedicated to technical rigor and operational efficiency, partnering with cross-functional departments to elevate our accounting processes to the next level.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Accountant, you will:

  • Prepare and post journal entries, perform balance sheet reconciliations, and drive high standards for period close improving quality and speed.

  • Own the preparation of audit schedules, coordinate responses to requests, and drive the closure of audit questions to ensure a predictable, well-documented process.

  • Deep dive into monthly results, flagging risks, unusual transactions, and key movements while providing decision-ready insights for finance leadership.

  • Identify accounting risks, implement practical mitigations, and strengthen internal controls to ensure our processes are scalable and accurate.

  • Actively leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and consistency, identifying opportunities to standardise and simplify recurring accounting work.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 6+ years of experience with a strong ability to apply IFRS in real-world scenarios.

  • Comfort working with consolidated results, analysing variances, and exercising complex accounting estimates and judgments.

  • Proven experience managing audits end-to-end or acting as the primary finance contact for external auditors.

  • A track record (or clear potential) of using AI and automation to improve accounting outcomes and efficiency.

  • The ability to operate effectively in a fast-changing environment with an "ownership mindset" and excellent judgment.

  • Strong ability to translate complex accounting issues into scalable process improvements and clear insights for stakeholders.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want genuine agency at group level rather than executing instructions handed down by a central team

  • You'd rather design a process than inherit one, and you want to see your own work implemented

  • You like variety. This is a different topic most days, not a fixed monthly cycle

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You want a settled, mature environment where the process is set and the day looks the same. That's the clearest reason this role doesn't work out for people

  • You need stable priorities. It's volatile here. Several topics run at once, progress depends on other people, and priorities can change overnight

  • You want to stay inside accounting. A large part of the job is working with teams outside Finance and with external advisors in each country

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 - 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the Audit Readiness initiative to drive impact in our year-end execution and documentation standards.

  • Collaborate with the Finance team to embed AI-forward ways of working, automating manual workflows to increase team capacity.

  • Grow your skills in process improvements and financial analysis, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale across our legal entity markets.

  • We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger leadership projects, mastering the intersection of AI and Finance, or deepening your expertise in complex consolidated reporting.

The location

This role is hybrid (on average, 3 days a week in the office) and can be located in either our Lisbon or Madrid office.

💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  • Hiring manager interview: A conversation with our Accounting Associate Director covering your technical accounting and IFRS experience.

  • Team panel and Pleo challenge: You'll meet the hiring manager, his manager and a peer from the team. The challenge is presented live in the session, so there's nothing to prepare or send in advance. We're looking at how you handle complexity, new areas and stakeholders.

  • Final interview: A closing conversation, used where it's helpful for both sides.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired this role, we received a lot of applications but can only interview a finite number of people. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD)
description:
Tired of retail pharmacy?

Imagine working in a modern, technology-enabled online pharmacy where you can focus on accuracy, quality and patient safety—without standing behind a retail counter, selling OTC products or being interrupted every few minutes.

No retail counter. No walk-in patients. No OTC. Focus entirely on delivering safe, high-quality pharmacy care.

Modern pharmacy. State of the art renovated premises with onsite Free parking

That's what we're building at Montu.

You will be a central, trusted part of our pharmacy operation at our Winnersh site — the person the team relies on to make sure every medicine that leaves our pharmacy is right.

As an Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD), you will be responsible for carrying out the final accuracy check on dispensed prescriptions before they are supplied to patients. You will act as an independent safeguard within the dispensing process, ensuring that medicines are assembled exactly as prescribed and in line with legal, operational and patient safety standards.

Getting it right the first time is non-negotiable. You will be trusted to exercise professional judgement, identify risks before they become incidents, and have the confidence to stop the process whenever something does not look right.

What will you be doing?

  • Carrying out the final accuracy check on dispensed medicines, confirming that the product supplied matches the prescription and accompanying documentation.

  • Verifying the right patient, right medicine, right strength, right formulation, right quantity and right directions, ensuring all labelling is accurate and appropriate.

  • Checking that medicines have been assembled in accordance with legal requirements, SOPs and company processes.

  • Identifying and escalating discrepancies, near misses and potential dispensing errors immediately, supporting a culture of openness and continuous improvement.

  • Maintaining clear, accurate and auditable records of all checks completed.

  • Exercising professional judgement and recognising when concerns fall outside your scope of practice, referring to the Responsible Pharmacist where appropriate.

  • Supporting the safe handling and checking of controlled drugs, unlicensed medicines and high-risk medications, in accordance with relevant legislation and internal procedures.

  • Ensuring appropriate expiry date checks, batch number verification (where applicable), and packaging integrity checks are completed before supply.

  • Working closely with dispensers, pharmacists and the wider pharmacy team to resolve queries efficiently while maintaining independence during the final checking process.

  • Contributing to quality assurance initiatives, investigations and process improvements aimed at reducing dispensing errors and improving patient safety.

  • Supporting and mentoring colleagues, helping to embed a culture of accountability, quality and attention to detail.

  • Remaining up to date with SOPs, regulatory requirements and best practice guidance to maintain competence and ensure the highest standards of checking.

What do you need?

  • An accredited Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD) qualification recognised for pharmacy dispensing practice.

  • Significant experience working within a pharmacy environment with a proven track record of conducting final accuracy checks.

  • A detailed understanding of the dispensing process and the critical control points that prevent medication errors.

  • Strong knowledge of pharmacy legislation, SOPs, governance requirements and patient safety principles.

  • The ability to work independently and make sound decisions while recognising the limits of your competence and escalating concerns appropriately.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain concentration and accuracy, even when working at pace.

  • Confidence to challenge discrepancies and halt the supply process when patient safety could be compromised.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • A proactive mindset, taking ownership of issues and following them through to resolution.

  • A genuine commitment to patient outcomes — understanding that every prescription represents a person relying on you to get it right.

What we offer:

  • Full-time contract: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, & Saturdays as either overtime or on a shift basis.

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

Technical

Encode recurring infra tasks as internal skills any teammate (human or agent) can pick up and run, so the team's throughput compounds — not just your own.

  • Debugging fluency. Lead incident response, post-mortems, and root-cause analyses — trace failures to the underlying problem (never the symptom), apply the learning back into the architecture, and prevent the same incident from happening twice.

  • Strategic vs. tactical balance. Balance this week's critical work with the 6–12-month platform direction — ship the on-call-driving fix today while shaping the multi-year observability, cost, and reliability investments that move WRITER's enterprise customers.

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Operate at the seams with product, security, and engineering peers — provide expert guidance on system design for reliability, performance, and scalability from conception through launch, Connect the infra agenda to product and revenue context, and disagree with evidence, not volume.

title: Senior Manager - Incentives
description:
This role sits within the Onboarding & Incentives pillar of the Rider Growth function at Deliveroo, this pillar owns the journey from the moment an applicant expresses interest through to a fully habituated, retained rider. We collaborate closely with Product, Data Science, Regional Operations, Rider Marketing and the Retention team to secure and retain a high-quality fleet.

We are seeking a Senior Manager to own three of the core engines behind our rider supply strategy: incentives, performance tracking, and target setting with scope to own wider areas of responsibility as these solutions are productionised.

  1. You will have overall accountability of our rider referral program from strategy to execution. You’ll partner closely with the Retention & Resurrection team on retention incentives, ensuring incentive spend across the rider lifecycle is efficient, well-targeted, and joined up. As part of this, you’ll design the governance frameworks needed to ensure all incentives across referrals, retention, resurrection and activation are operating efficiently and tests are designed robustly.

  2. You will also own performance tracking of rider hours end-to-end, partnering with teams across acquisition, conversion, activation, and retention to understand the forecast and actuals behind their initiatives, and working with Data Science to attribute causality to that work – giving senior stakeholders an accurate, defensible read on how our supply investments are performing.

  3. Finally, you will own our rider applicant target-setting model which is used to determine our rider acquisition forecasts vs top-down targets, working with Science and local Regional Operations teams. Improvements here will ensure we’re able to plan for longer time horizons with greater degrees of accuracy as well as scenario planning with our Rider Marketing team to drive efficiencies in cost per applicant.

What we’re looking for

  • Analytical Rigor: You are highly comfortable building and defending forecasting, target-setting, and attribution models, and can translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Ownership & Follow-Through: You take full accountability for the incentives and reporting you own, proactively flagging risks to plan and driving fixes end-to-end.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: You work effectively across Data Science, Regional Operations, Retention & Resurrection, and Rider Marketing to align on shared goals and targets.

  • Stakeholder Communication: You can distil complex performance and target-setting narratives into clear, credible updates for senior stakeholders.

What you'll be doing

  • Referral & Reactivation Incentives: Own the end-to-end strategy, performance, and budget for rider referral and reactivation incentive programmes, continuously testing and iterating to improve efficiency.

  • Retention Incentive Partnership: Partner closely with the Retention & Resurrection team on retention incentives, ensuring a joined-up approach to incentive spend across the rider lifecycle.

  • Rider Hours Performance Tracking: Own tracking of rider hours performance, partnering with teams across acquisition, conversion, activation, and retention to understand the forecast and actuals behind their initiatives.

  • Causal Attribution: Partner with Data Science to attribute causality to individual initiatives’ contribution to rider hours, building a robust and defensible measurement framework.

  • Senior Stakeholder Reporting: Ensure rider hours performance and initiative impact are reported accurately and clearly to senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

  • Weekly Applicant Target Setting: Own the weekly rider applicant target-setting process, ensuring targets reflect the latest view of demand, funnel performance, and onboarding capacity.

  • Annual Planning: Lead applicant target setting within the annual planning cycle, working with Science and local Regional Operations teams to work back from onboard targets to applicant targets.

  • Scenario Planning & Cost Efficiency: Run scenario planning with the Rider Marketing team to stress-test target and budget assumptions and identify opportunities to drive down cost per applicant.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Build strong working relationships across Science, Regional Operations, Retention & Resurrection, and Rider Marketing to keep incentive, performance, and target-setting decisions aligned.

Requirements

  • Experience in Operations, Strategy & Operations, or Growth/Performance Marketing, ideally within a high-growth marketplace or on-demand business.

  • Proven experience owning incentive programmes or performance-based spend, including budget management and ROI measurement.

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with experience in forecasting, target setting, and/or causal measurement.

  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Data Science, Regional Operations, and Marketing to align on targets and reporting.

  • Comfortable presenting performance data and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

title: Partner Operations Manager
description:
Partner Operations Manager

The Global Merchant Excellence team

The Merchant excellence team supports accountable for supporting restaurant and retail partners across all markets with key onboarding and lifecycle tasks, acting as their operational support team once they’re live on the platform.

The team:

  • Manages partner contacts across live and non‑live channels globally, with UKIE representing the largest share of demand.

  • Handles admin and technical tasks for SMB, Mid‑Market and National partners (e.g. account and menu creation, menu edits, tablet installation and troubleshooting, photography, compliance actions like DAC7, refund disputes, and inbound phone/chat support).

  • Acts as the sole point of contact for self‑serve partners after they “graduate” from early‑life onboarding, working closely with New Partner Experience and Account Management teams.

Operationally, most day‑to‑day volume is handled by third‑party vendors aligned by language and market, with in‑house L2 teams owning complex queries, escalations, and performance management across markets.

In this role you'll be involved in these key areas:

  1. Managing channel, queue and team leader/ agent performance across our in-house teams in Manchester, UK and Milan, Italy.

  2. Identifying trends in performance and conducting root cause analysis (e.g. Team Leader/agent productivity) to drive improved performance.

  3. Helping define new metrics, targets and best practices to drive improvements in Merchant experience (e.g. first touch resolution)

  4. Present market performance updates and strategic implications to executive leadership.

  5. Identify Operational efficiencies that can be gained through automation and process improvements.

All these activities may extend to other LOBs as well as Partner Operations.

  • What new benefits should we launch for Subscription - which ideas are worth pursuing, and what's the business case for each?

  • How do we prioritise and sequence a pipeline of benefit ideas against limited engineering, design, and operational capacity?

  • How do we define success for a new benefit before launch - what does a good outcome look like, and what would tell us to kill it?

  • Once live, how is a benefit actually performing - impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and member satisfaction - against its cost to serve, and what does that tell us to do next?

  • How do we take a benefit from a small pilot to a scaled, steady-state feature, and what needs to be true operationally for that to work?

What you'll be doing

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for new benefits within Subscription - build the analysis, the business case, and the plan, and drive it through to execution.

  • Cross-functional delivery - partner with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and Finance to take benefit ideas from concept to launch, without formal authority over any of them.

  • Build and prioritise the benefit pipeline - evaluate a stream of ideas (experiential, use-case specific, or otherwise), size their potential impact and cost, and decide what's worth building next.

  • Track ongoing performance - maintain visibility into each live benefit's impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and satisfaction against its cost to serve, flagging when something needs attention.

  • Scale what works - take benefits from small pilots to steady-state features, defining the operating model, reporting cadence, and processes needed to run them sustainably.

  • Bring outside-in perspective - track what Uber One, DashPass, Wolt+, Just Eat and Amazon Prime are doing with membership benefits, and translate what's relevant into Deliveroo's context.

  • Communicate to senior stakeholders - write clear strategy documents and present recommendations, trade-offs, and results to leadership.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in strategy & operations, strategy consulting, or business operations - ideally with exposure to marketplaces, subscription/membership businesses, or consumer tech.

  • Commercial acumen: strong understanding of marketplace dynamics and subscriber value; comfortable building a business case and owning a set of P&L-adjacent metrics.

  • Analytical rigor: comfortable interpreting data and experiment results to make a clear business call - you'll partner with Data Science on the "how" and "so what."

  • Bias for action and ownership: able to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous problems ("what should we build, and how will we know it worked?"), and to drive execution personally rather than just recommend.

  • Cross-functional influence: track record of aligning senior stakeholders and diverse functions (Product, Eng, Finance, Marketing) around a shared plan in a fast-moving, matrixed environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication - able to distill complex trade-offs into a clear recommendation for leadership.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

Workplace & Benefits

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. By acting as trusted technical advisors, you and your team will utilize deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition—showcasing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and accelerated time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in thermal physics and cooling strategies, you will guide analyses of complex thermal management systems, fluid flow dynamics, and heat dissipation challenges. This includes both steady-state and transient thermal behavior. Your team will help customers evaluate critical factors such as thermal risk, component reliability, power density, and cooling efficiency to architect cutting-edge thermal management systems for next-generation hardware.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. Additionally, you will serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermal engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermal management and cooling solutions — either as a practitioner running simulations, or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with structural mechanical simulations (FEA/stress) and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI, Be part of a team that is actively redefining how the next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state of the art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise

Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

À propos de Vinci

Nous développons une technologie d’IA basée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme logicielle aide les concepteurs hardware et les ingénieur·es en simulation physique à explorer, analyser et optimiser des systèmes complexes, en s’appuyant sur des technologies d’IA de pointe pour fournir une intelligence physique ultra-rapide et précise, intégrée aux réalités des processus de conception en ingénierie.

Notre premier produit comble le fossé entre la précision et le déterminisme des simulations traditionnelles et la rapidité et la capacité de mise à l’échelle de l’IA. Il redéfinit la manière dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés, fabriqués, mis sur le marché et intégrés dans des systèmes complexes.

Présentation du poste

En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l’adoption de la plateforme Vinci auprès des principales organisations d’ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante d’ingénieur·es thermiques, dédiée à l’accompagnement de clients potentiels et à la démonstration de la valeur transformative de notre logiciel.

En tant que conseiller·ère technique de confiance, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous porterez la proposition de valeur de Vinci en démontrant comment notre plateforme permet d’améliorer de manière systémique les performances thermiques, la fiabilité des produits et la vitesse de mise sur le marché.

Grâce à de solides fondamentaux en physique thermique et en stratégies de refroidissement, vous guiderez l’analyse de systèmes complexes de gestion thermique, de dynamiques des écoulements de fluides et de problématiques de dissipation thermique. Cela inclut aussi bien les comportements thermiques en régime permanent que transitoire. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des facteurs critiques tels que les risques thermiques, la fiabilité des composants, la densité de puissance et l’efficacité du refroidissement afin de concevoir des systèmes de gestion thermique de pointe pour les matériels de nouvelle génération.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie des clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et d’expliquer clairement les capacités de Vinci à résoudre des problèmes concrets. Vous serez également un relais essentiel entre les clients et nos équipes Produit et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables permettant d’orienter la feuille de route produit et d’alimenter l’amélioration continue.

Il s’agit d’un poste basé en France et en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie, aux États-Unis. Le poste implique des déplacements modérés, principalement en Europe continentale. Des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pourront également être nécessaires pour des échanges et des collaborations avec l’équipe américaine.

Responsabilités

  • Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d’ingénieur·es thermiques, en définissant l’orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l’équipe, et en pilotant l’exécution sur le terrain à travers l’Europe.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels.

  • Accompagner les équipes d’ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d’évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l’exécution de cas de test complexes et l’interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci.

  • Piloter l’accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l’onboarding, le déploiement et l’expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes.

  • Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés.

  • Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d’événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme.

  • Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci.

Qualifications (Qualifications minimales)

Formation : Diplôme en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié.

Expertise technique : Maîtrise experte de logiciels de simulation commerciaux (Flotherm, Ansys Icepak/Fluent, Simcenter STAR-CCM+ ou équivalent), avec plus de 15 ans d’expérience pratique en gestion thermique et solutions de refroidissement — soit en tant que praticien·ne réalisant des simulations, soit en tant que Technical Account Manager pour des logiciels commerciaux de simulation physique.

Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies.

Relation client : Expérience préalable dans des fonctions directement orientées client, avec une forte capacité à établir une relation de confiance et à gérer des relations avec des clients issus de l’ingénierie.

Automatisation & scripting : Expérience pratique en programmation avec Python ou C++ pour automatiser des workflows ou analyser des données issues de simulations.

Leadership : Expérience avérée en management ou en leadership technique, avec la capacité à développer une équipe, accompagner ses membres et piloter l’exécution au sein d’équipes d’ingénierie.

Communication : Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, avec une capacité démontrée à transformer des résultats complexes de physique et de simulation en messages clairs et à fort impact, aussi bien pour des interlocuteurs techniques de haut niveau que pour des dirigeants orientés business.

Profil recherché (Atouts différenciants)

Expertise multiphysique : Connaissance des simulations mécaniques structurelles (FEA/contraintes) et/ou des workflows de Signal Integrity et Power Integrity (SI/PI).

Expérience commerciale : Expérience directe dans la commercialisation de logiciels techniques — idéalement des outils d’Electronic Design Automation (EDA) ou de simulation CAE — auprès de grandes entreprises des secteurs des semi-conducteurs et de l’électronique.

Expérience Go-to-Market : Expérience préalable dans des environnements de pré-vente technique, d’application engineering (FAE) ou de vente technique stratégique.

Technologies émergentes : Capacité à adopter rapidement et à promouvoir des workflows de nouvelle génération basés sur la physique ainsi que des outils de conception ou de simulation assistés par l’IA.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Ne vous contentez pas d’utiliser l’IA : rejoignez une équipe qui redéfinit activement la manière dont le silicium et les systèmes hardware de nouvelle génération sont conçus.

  • Travaillez à la convergence de modèles d’IA de pointe, de la physique fondamentale et de projets industriels à forts enjeux.

  • Collaborez avec des ingénieur·es et chercheur·ses de renommée mondiale dans un environnement startup dynamique et en pleine évolution.

Compensation: €120K – €130K

The Shipping Group owns everything that moves at Back Market – from the moment a seller configures their listings to the moment a customer's order is delivered. We're organized across two squads and one strategic program:

  • Shipping Core squad – BackShip (managed labels, carrier network, billing, warranty), transit time infrastructure, carrier optimization, and collection point UX

  • Delivery Experience (DXP) squad – Customer-facing delivery promise (PDP, Cart, Checkout), post-dispatch tracking, and delivery notifications

  • BFF program – Back Market's logistic infrastructure, which integrates our fulfillment, trade-in, and B2B operations.

Shipping Core and DXP are deeply interdependent: Shipping Core builds the rails, DXP surfaces them to customers. Our products directly impact €3.5B+ in annual GMV and every single order placed on the platform.

About the scope

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own BackShip – Back Market's managed shipping solution for sellers, and one of the highest-leverage infrastructure bets in the company.

BackShip is how Back Market takes control of the physical flow of goods: instead of relying on sellers to choose their own carriers, Back Market negotiates the rates, generates the labels, and manages the carrier relationship end-to-end. It's both a seller-facing product and the core infrastructure layer that will power Back Market's own fulfillment operations (BFF) at scale.

Currently, BackShip sees a minority of our sellers using the service. We aim to significantly grow this adoption rate in the coming years, which is expected to generate substantial additional revenue.

You'll own six product domains:

  • Label Generation — Generate shipment labels for every order flow via our integrations with Teliae and Intersoft; distribute labels to sellers, customers, and agents; manage Tradelines configuration

  • Delivery Services — Pickup requests, Carrier-side collection point shipping method, QR code returns (e.g. UPS US), and future delivery modes as we expand the carrier network

  • BackShip Billing — Receive and process carrier invoices; bill logistics costs back to sellers; own logistic cost data feeding CCBM and Backbox

  • BackShip Warranty — For every shipment, decide whether BM applies carrier insurance or BM's own warranty; maintain warranty configuration across carriers and markets

  • Carrier Optimization — Smart routing (greenfield initiative — not yet existing); this is yours to define and build

  • BackShip Support — Own the seller support experience for BackShip-related issues, in coordination with Seller Success

Business Impact

  • Own business outcomes with full accountability for BackShip attachment rate, carrier operational performance, and billing accuracy

  • Increase BackShip attachment rate by understanding why sellers adopt, why they churn, and what it takes to make BackShip the obvious default

  • Develop and communicate product priorities by synthesizing insights from sellers, carrier partners, logistics market trends, and internal data

Product Leadership

  • Lead your squad – own the roadmap and execution, make decisions with your engineering team, and foster autonomy while maintaining strategic alignment

  • Contribute to Shipping Group strategy – define your team’s tactic, lead cross-squad initiatives, and influence company-level logistics OKRs

  • Be the primary BackShip voice in the BFF program – ensuring label generation, carrier integrations, and pickup orchestration

Product Development

  • Lead end-to-end lifecycle of complex features from conception to launch – including Carrier Optimization (smart routing), BackShip Billing dashboard, collection point shipping method expansion, and BFF outbound integration

  • Prioritize ruthlessly, balancing seller adoption, carrier reliability, billing accuracy, and BFF readiness — and know when operational excellence is the product

Collaboration

  • Work closely with your Engineering Manager and engineering team to deliver with quick time-to-market and optimal resources

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders – Seller Success (onboarding, adoption), Finance (carrier invoices, CCBM data), Delivery Experience (collection point UX, promise accuracy), and the BFF program team

  • Work directly with external carrier partners (Colissimo, DHL, UPS, Chronopost, Royal Mail, and others) – you are the product owner of those relationships on the integration side

User Experience

  • Constantly evaluate seller satisfaction with BackShip – understand the friction points that prevent adoption and the operational pain points that cause churn

  • Stay ahead of logistics and carrier trends – know what competitors, 3PLs, and carrier networks are doing, and bring best practices into our product

  • Master your problem space – become the go-to expert on seller shipping operations; talk regularly with sellers, monitor carrier performance data, and own the feedback loop between the field and the roadmap.

About the role

  • 5+ years in Product Management with 2+ years in logistics, carrier operations, or marketplace infrastructure – You understand how carrier networks work, how integrations are built, and what makes a managed shipping product actually get adopted by merchants

  • Track record of shipping complex operational products with business impact – You've owned adoption or attachment metrics, delivered measurable revenue outcomes, and navigated the complexity of external partner dependencies (carriers, 3PLs, integrators)

  • Experience growing B2B product adoption – You know how to move an attachment rate, not just ship features; you've worked on onboarding funnels, commercial positioning, and seller activation loops

  • Carrier and logistics ecosystem knowledge – You understand label generation, carrier API integrations, pickup orchestration, transit time mechanics, warranty and insurance models, and how SLAs are structured with logistics partners Billing and operational data fluency – You're comfortable owning a billing product; you understand invoice processing, cost allocation, and how logistics cost data feeds financial reporting (P&L, CCBM)

  • Strong data-driven mindset – You use carrier performance metrics, adoption funnels, A/B testing, and seller research to drive decisions; bonus points for SQL/data analysis skills

  • Strategic thinker with execution excellence – You can define a 3-year vision for smart routing while also unblocking a label generation bug on a Friday afternoon; you balance long-term infrastructure bets with short-term operational reliability

  • Leading without authority and tribe-level influence – You align carrier partners, finance, seller success, and engineering independently; you are trusted beyond your squad and represent BackShip credibly in cross-functional programs like BFF

  • Excellent communicator and collaborator – You can translate carrier integration complexity into clear seller value propositions, navigate commercial conversations with logistics partners, and make billing data legible to finance stakeholders

  • Passionate about sustainability and seller empowerment – Back Market's mission resonates with your personal values; you understand that scaling BackShip is not just a revenue play — it's how we make sustainable commerce operationally viable at scale

The Production Team Leader is responsible for the optimization of resource allocation to meet global SLAs while maintaining data integrity and cost-efficiency.

title: Representant(e) commercial(e) - Team lead - Strasbourg
description:
Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Notre ancrage en France est déjà un succès incontestable. Face à une demande qui explose et pour soutenir cette dynamique, nous passons à la vitesse supérieure et recherchons nos prochains leaders sur le marché français.

L'opportunité : Soyons clairs dès le départ

Ce poste n'est pas un poste de manager classique. Pendant les 6 premiers mois, tu es sur le terrain, en tant que commercial(e) à part entière avec des objectifs de vente individuels, comme chaque membre de l'équipe.

Pourquoi ? Parce que chez Salonkee, on ne peut diriger que ce que l'on maîtrise. Avant de coacher une équipe sur la prospection, les démos et le closing, tu dois connaître le marché, les salons et notre produit sur le bout des doigts. C'est notre garantie de qualité pour toi, pour ton équipe, et pour nos clients.

Si tu cherches un rôle de management à distance, derrière un tableau Excel, ce poste n'est pas fait pour toi. Si tu veux gagner ta légitimité sur le terrain avant de prendre les rênes, continue à lire.

Tes missions

Phase 1 : Tu vends.

  • Prospection terrain : Tu démarches activement les salons de coiffure et instituts de beauté de ta zone; porte-à-porte, démos en direct, closing.

  • Objectifs individuels : Tu portes les mêmes objectifs de vente qu'un(e) commercial(e) terrain. Ta performance est mesurée, suivie, et récompensée.

  • Apprentissage du marché : Tu comprends dans le détail les besoins des salons, les objections récurrentes et ce qui fait signer un·e gérant·e.

  • Maîtrise des outils : CRM impeccable, pipeline propre, reporting fiable; tu appliques ce que tu exigeras plus tard de ton équipe.

Phase 2 : Tu construis et tu diriges.

  • Constitution de ton équipe : Tu participes au recrutement et fais grandir ton équipe jusqu'à environ 5 personnes (et plus en cas de succès).

  • Lead by example : Tu passes plus de 80 % de ton temps sur le terrain avec ton équipe; tu accompagnes et tu coaches la prospection, tu assistes aux démos et tu aides activement à transformer les opportunités en signatures.

  • Structure & coaching : Tu organises la semaine, tu animes les 1:1 et les roleplays, tu lèves les obstacles rapidement et tu veilles à la rigueur du CRM de toute l'équipe.

  • Pilotage par les chiffres : Tu connais les indicateurs clés de chaque membre de ton équipe et tu pilotes activement la performance.

  • Culture & motivation : Tu crées des challenges d'équipe, tu renforces la culture sales et tu fais en sorte que chacun(e) progresse en continu.

Ton profil

  • Passion pour la vente terrain : Au moins 3 à 4 ans d'expérience en vente terrain / commerce itinérant (le B2B est un plus). Tu adores être en première ligne.

  • Potentiel de leadership : Tu n'as pas besoin d'avoir déjà été manager, mais tu as l'envie et le talent de prendre la responsabilité d'une région et de mener une équipe au succès.

  • Autonomie & sens stratégique : Tu planifies tes activités en toute autonomie, tu fixes des priorités claires et trouves des moyens intelligents d'implanter Salonkee dans ta région.

  • Affinité tech : Bonne compréhension des solutions digitales et solide expérience des CRM.

  • Mobilité : Permis B indispensable, Tu gères en totale autonomie la région de Strasbourg et alentours.

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales..

Ce que nous offrons

  • Rémunération attractive : Un fixe solide + des commissions non plafonnées; ta performance paie, dès le premier mois et à chaque étape.

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Un plan d'évolution transparent : Du terrain vers le leadership, avec des jalons définis dès ton arrivée.

  • Organisation autonome : Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • Mutuelle

  • Tickets-restaurant

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même.

Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité.

Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Notre ancrage en France est déjà un succès incontestable. Face à une demande qui explose et pour soutenir cette dynamique, nous passons à la vitesse supérieure et recherchons nos prochains leaders sur le marché français.

L'opportunité : Soyons clairs dès le départ

Ce poste n'est pas un poste de manager classique. Pendant les 6 premiers mois, tu es sur le terrain, en tant que commercial(e) à part entière avec des objectifs de vente individuels, comme chaque membre de l'équipe.

Pourquoi ? Parce que chez Salonkee, on ne peut diriger que ce que l'on maîtrise. Avant de coacher une équipe sur la prospection, les démos et le closing, tu dois connaître le marché, les salons et notre produit sur le bout des doigts. C'est notre garantie de qualité pour toi, pour ton équipe, et pour nos clients.

Si tu cherches un rôle de management à distance, derrière un tableau Excel, ce poste n'est pas fait pour toi. Si tu veux gagner ta légitimité sur le terrain avant de prendre les rênes, continue à lire.

Tes missions

Phase 1 : Tu vends.

  • Prospection terrain : Tu démarches activement les salons de coiffure et instituts de beauté de ta zone; porte-à-porte, démos en direct, closing.

  • Objectifs individuels : Tu portes les mêmes objectifs de vente qu'un(e) commercial(e) terrain. Ta performance est mesurée, suivie, et récompensée.

  • Apprentissage du marché : Tu comprends dans le détail les besoins des salons, les objections récurrentes et ce qui fait signer un·e gérant·e.

  • Maîtrise des outils : CRM impeccable, pipeline propre, reporting fiable; tu appliques ce que tu exigeras plus tard de ton équipe.

Phase 2 : Tu construis et tu diriges.

  • Constitution de ton équipe : Tu participes au recrutement et fais grandir ton équipe jusqu'à environ 5 personnes (et plus en cas de succès).

  • Lead by example : Tu passes plus de 80 % de ton temps sur le terrain avec ton équipe; tu accompagnes et tu coaches la prospection, tu assistes aux démos et tu aides activement à transformer les opportunités en signatures.

  • Structure & coaching : Tu organises la semaine, tu animes les 1:1 et les roleplays, tu lèves les obstacles rapidement et tu veilles à la rigueur du CRM de toute l'équipe.

  • Pilotage par les chiffres : Tu connais les indicateurs clés de chaque membre de ton équipe et tu pilotes activement la performance.

  • Culture & motivation : Tu crées des challenges d'équipe, tu renforces la culture sales et tu fais en sorte que chacun(e) progresse en continu.

Ton profil

  • Passion pour la vente terrain : Au moins 3 à 4 ans d'expérience en vente terrain / commerce itinérant (le B2B est un plus). Tu adores être en première ligne.

  • Potentiel de leadership : Tu n'as pas besoin d'avoir déjà été manager, mais tu as l'envie et le talent de prendre la responsabilité d'une région et de mener une équipe au succès.

  • Autonomie & sens stratégique : Tu planifies tes activités en toute autonomie, tu fixes des priorités claires et trouves des moyens intelligents d'implanter Salonkee dans ta région.

  • Affinité tech : Bonne compréhension des solutions digitales et solide expérience des CRM.

  • Mobilité : Permis B indispensable, Tu gères en totale autonomie la région de Clermont-Ferrand et alentours.

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales..

Ce que nous offrons

  • Rémunération attractive : Un fixe solide + des commissions non plafonnées; ta performance paie, dès le premier mois et à chaque étape.

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Un plan d'évolution transparent : Du terrain vers le leadership, avec des jalons définis dès ton arrivée.

  • Organisation autonome : Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • Mutuelle

  • Tickets-restaurant

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même.

Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité.

title: Représentant(e) commercial(e) - Compiègne & alentours
description:
Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Après avoir digitalisé le secteur de la beauté dans plusieurs pays d'Europe, nous recherchons nos premiers commerciaux pour faire de la France une de nos plus grandes réussites.

L'opportunité

Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor.

Tes missions

  • Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) : tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats.

  • Ambassadeur(rice) de terrain : tu mènes des présentations produits directement sur site pour démontrer, avec clarté et conviction, la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions pour le business de tes clients.

  • Conseil stratégique & optimisation : tu accompagnes tes prospects avec expertise en leur proposant des solutions digitales sur mesure pour optimiser leurs processus et libérer tout leur potentiel de croissance.

  • Stratégie multicanale : tu utilises différents canaux de communication pour approcher les clients potentiels et développer des relations de confiance durables.

  • Accompagnement & formation : tu assures la formation de tes nouveaux clients pour garantir une adoption parfaite de l'outil et un succès immédiat dès le premier jour d'utilisation.

Ton profil

  • Expérience sales : pas besoin d'un CV parfait; ce qu'on cherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un avec la fibre commerciale et le drive pour aller chercher le client. Une première expérience en vente terrain B2B ou en prospection téléphone/physique est un vrai atout: tu sais ce que c'est que d'aller chercher le client là où il est

  • Tempérament chasseur : tu as le goût du challenge, une résilience à toute épreuve et une appétence naturelle pour la prospection active

  • Autonomie & organisation : véritable self-starter, tu planifies tes journées de façon stratégique et trouves les meilleurs leviers pour établir Salonkee dans ton secteur

  • Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants

  • Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech: la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus.

  • Mobilité : le permis B est indispensable. Tu gères en totale autonomie la région Compiègne & alentours.

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un salaire fixe entre 28.000 € et 34.000 € brut annuel + variable déplafonné (OTE cible : 39.000 € – 45.000 €). Ton succès, ton revenu

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Organisation autonome. Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • Un parcours d'intégration structuré : formation produit, accompagnement terrain avec ton manager les premières semaines, et accès à l'expérience de nos équipes déjà en place dans 6 autres pays

  • Un accès direct au leadership et une vraie capacité d'influence sur la stratégie commerciale dès tes premiers mois

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

title: Forward Deployed Consultant
description:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organisations work and outpace their competition.

Our team is growing and we are looking for a Forward Deployed Consultant to join our Professional Services team! In this role, you will train, advise and consult, and build with customers to optimize their use of the monday.com AI work platform during the course of an AI transformation, implementation, or ongoing managed services engagement. You will design and build the AI-native solutions that get them there, from intelligent workflows and agents to the automations and reporting their business relies on. You will run engagements both independently and as a part of a delivery team collaborating with deployment strategists and engineers.

Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our Paris office.

About the Role

  • Lead AI transformation and implementation engagements for monday.com customers, designing and building tailored solutions using agents, vibe-coded applications, and other advanced capabilities of the monday AI work platform.

  • Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, running the discovery that uncovers their desired business outcomes, and ensure successful adoption of the solutions you deliver across their organization.

  • Consult on business process design, mapping how work moves through a customer's organization and recommending the process changes that should be made before the solution is built.

  • Design sophisticated workflows and relational data structures within the monday.com platform to solve complex business cases, partnering with technical resources for data conversions, integrations, and agentic engineering.

  • Actively leverage monday AI and external Generative/Agentic AI tools to accelerate solution design, automate complex business logic, and deliver intelligent workflows for our customers.

  • Act as the project manager on standalone engagements, building and executing on project plans that ensure deliverables stay on-time and on-budget, and delivering defined scope alongside a deployment strategist on larger ones.

  • Run online webinars, training sessions, consultations, and one-on-one demos that show customers how our product capabilities translate into business value.

  • Produce the documentation, walkthroughs, and exit artifacts for your engagements that allow customers to operate, maintain, and extend what you built independently.

  • Represent the voice of the customer by advocating for their needs and influencing the product development roadmap.

  • Contribute the patterns and reusable assets you develop in the field back to our shared asset library.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a forward deployed consultant, implementation consultant, solutions consultant, or technical project manager in enterprise software.

  • Experience leading software implementation or managed services projects that required hands-on build and system configuration in project management, CRM, service desk, or collaborative work management software.

  • Exigeant·e mais pragmatique, tu sais défendre la qualité UI tout en tenant compte des contraintes techniques, de performance, d’accessibilité et de faisabilité.


Mon avis de recruteuse sur ce job :

Un très beau job pour un·e UI Designer qui veut passer un cap : une marque internationale qui fait rêver, un cadre de vie exceptionnel à Annecy, des sujets eCommerce concrets, et un niveau design system/UX/ produit rare. Ici, on ne cherche pas quelqu’un pour “faire des écrans”, mais une vraie Pépite capable de challenger, structurer, aligner et faire briller l’expérience eCommerce d’une marque iconique. Bref : du beau design, du vrai produit, de la montagne… Difficile de faire plus séduisant !
